content:
BUILT CoLAB is one of the institutions that will be present at the India-Portugal Technology Summit, which takes place between 7 and 9 December, in a totally online event.

Portugal is the guest country of honor of this event, organized by the Government of the Republic of India, coordinated in Portugal by FCT in collaboration with the National Innovation Agency, Portugal Space, and the AIR Centre.

This summit aims to create bilateral partnerships in science and technology, as well as strengthen the relationship already existing in the most varied areas of knowledge such as Watertech, Agritech, Healthtech, Energy, Climate change, Cleantech, IT, ICT & Advanced technologies, and Space-Ocean Interactions.

The event will be attended by the Ministers of Science of Portugal and India, as well as representatives of academia and the industrial sector of the two countries. Plenary, thematic, and business sessions will take place over the 3 days. It will be possible to schedule virtual meetings with the companies present and virtual stands will be available where institutions can present themselves to the public.

Registration is free but mandatory.
